arxiv-1907-00307.description: Abstract We consider the robust filtering problem for a nonlinear state-space model with outliers in measurements. pmc-13382137.description: SummarySpermidine (SPD), a polyamine essential for various biological processes, has long been recognized as a signaling molecule. In this study, we uncover a previously unknown mechanism whereby SPD selectively binds to small regulatory RNAs, driving their degradation and subsequently modulating virulence in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
